verdict.rationale: Signifyd documents a REST API and mentions mobile SDKs providing self-contained libraries with instructions and project files for developers, but there's no evidence of official SDKs for common AI-native languages/frameworks (e.g., Python, Node.js server-side SDKs) or GitHub repos with examples typically expected for building AI-native integrations. missing for 10: public SDK repositories/package manager listings, language-specific SDK docs beyond mobile, examples of AI-agent-friendly usage.
